scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Ma aragtay inoo binu waqafsan oo loo soo diray qoraalka nidaamka cusub ee nidaamka bus?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxaan akriyay. Goortii daloolowga ayay yidhaahdaan waxay caawiso, dad badan baa ku khilaafa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa dhibta ugu weyn tahay xiisooyinka. Waxay u badisaa kharaajiyada, waxaana u badisaa taathir weyn iyo shaqo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Suuragal ah, laakiin waxay yidhaahdaan waxay u badisaa shaqo badan. Ma adkaan waxay go'aansamaan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin haday qaateen adeegyada kale, waxay noqon doontaa dhibaato. Dadka waxay u badisaa taathir weyn in ay maleyneyn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Waan ku sugnaa iyo waxaan arkaan. Goortii aan qalqaan, waxaan rajeynayaa ay go'aansamaan go'aan wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxaan u maleynayaa rajeynayaa. Berri baa waxaan soo celin doonaa warbixinta berri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Anigu ma u dooran qorsheygaaga inaad tashi tashada, laakiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: Owgaayn waxaan beddel karnaa waqtiga kaddib markii aan beddelno meeshii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Waxay nuqul qofka wanaagsan, laakiin anigu ma adkeeyo inay tahay xaliyadda ugu fiican inaanan wada hadalno hadda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: Owgaayn waxaan u baahnahay inaan u dooranno mar walba aan la wada hadalno.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u dooran, laakiin weli waxaan u maleynayaa in qorsheygu xaal u leh, haddii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: Owgaayn waxaan u baahnahay inaan jarribno qorshe kale, owgaayn waxaan u baahnahay inaan jarribno qorshe kale, kaddib markii aan jarribno qorshe kale?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxay u shaqayn karaysaa aan lahayn dhibaato. Waxaan u baahnahay inaan u sameeyno, laakiin.

key_phrases.translation: Waxaan u baahnahay inaan u sameeyno, laakiin.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work

vocabulary.note: Waxay u adeegsan tahay inay soo sheegto waxaan u dhaqmaynta in wax aan dhacayn ilaa halka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan akhriymay qoraagaaga, laakiin qaybta ugu dambeeya ma oga hadana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Waa fiican. Nuquliyadda bilowgii waa adag fiican, waxaan u maleynayaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ku liqi doonaa, sey ahaan waxaannu u baahnahay ina wanaajiyoo dhammaadka si aad u badan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Haa, natiijada ma jirin adag fiican. Sey ahaan, fikradahaa waa qalad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Mahadsanid. Maxaan ka fiiri kartaa wax kalaso dhanka ugu dambeeya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa la yaabi in la daroo miyir yar, oo aad soo bandhigto dalil adag oo ku saabsan da’wadaada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Waa fiican, waxaan ku shaqeyn doonaa. Ma ay tixraacsan doontaa iiga soo jeeda macluumaadka?

key_phrases.translation: Maxaan ka fiiri kartaa wax kale?
Ma ay tixraacsan doontaa iiga soo jeeda...

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Halen, shakishii aan kaxay helay, laakiin midka ugu jirta khalaad ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Waan ka xumahayaa inaan maqlo. Ma ayad iga soo dirtid sawir oo leh waxaad helay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Haddii, waan soo diri doonaa si degdeg ah. Sidaa darteed, waan u baahan yahay inaan soo celiyo waxa iibsan oo aan hel bixinta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Waana adag yahay. Ma ayay ku qaadi doonin bixinta. Fadlan u hub iimaylkaga wax ka badan tijaabada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Mahadsanid. Sidee ayay u dhiman doontaa inaan sugan hel bixinta?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Kadibna wuxuu qaataa 5-7 maalmo. Fadlan u diyaari la'aan gelitaanka soo celinta aan ku siinay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Wacan, waan noqon doonaa diyaar. Mahadsanid dhibaatan ku celisay.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxay u adeegsan tahay xoolo ama da'da, waxay ka kooban tahay 'get'.
Waxay u tali galaysa tijaabada shaqo, 'shaqo jira' ma aha.
Waa la soo daray si loo buuxiyo tirada, laakiin waa la soo daray si loo buuxiyo tirada.

vocabulary.translation: u tali galay, u tali galay
vocabulary.note: Waxay u tali galaysa 'u tali galay'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Waan rabnaa inaan guulaysiiyo wez weyn oo shaqadaada, laakiin waxaan ogahay inuu baahan yahay haybad badan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Waa da'da weyn. Waa maxay nooca wez oo aad rabta inaad gudbisay mustaqbalka?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Waan jeclaa inaan u tali galay koox, laakiin waxaan u maleynayaa inaan baahan yahay tajribo badan oo dhan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Owki waa inaad helaysid fursado inaad u tali galato shuruud yar oo shaqo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Sidaas baa aan u maleynayaa. Guul ma aha waxa uu soo baxayo habeenka, sidaas daraaddeed waan ka haddaan inaan wax baro oo aan ku wada hadlo qaladeyda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Waa fiiri aad u fiican. Waxaan ogahay inaad guulaysiisid wax kasta oo aad u maleynaysid.

key_phrases.translation: guul ma aha waxa uu soo baxayo habeenka

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle

Shuqulka nabadgelyada.

Xidhiidh sabab.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Waan ku dadaalaa inaan subaxda u firiyaa, laakiin aan marta u dhexeeyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Waa fiican. Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa inaad maqashis jidhkaaga oo aad helisad riyood oo kugu soo saabsan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Waan ogahay. Waxaan u badan baa fiican yahay markaan malad leh nabadgelyada maalintii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Haa, oo nabadgelyadu waa qayb muhiim ah. Ma nabad gashay ugu yaraan toddoba saacad?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Kadib kadib, haa. Laakiin dhibkaygu ugu muhiimsan waa xanuunka, aan nahay nabadgelyada.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Xanuunku wuxuu u dhex dhigeeyaa dhabtaada badan. Markaasaa ayaad u baahan tahay riyood cusub inaad u adag tahay, sida akhrin ama tashan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Waa fikrad fiican, maxaa yeelay waxaan rabaa inaan u dhab ahay dhammaan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Sidee ay ahaa safarkaaga buuroyinka ugu dambeeyey?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Waxay ahaayd waaweyn, laakiin waxay noqotay inaan ka soo gaarnay in aan u soo gaarnay ilaa aan u soo gaarnay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Ma joogtay hotel ama cabdarrad?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Waxay joogay cabdarrad yar oo arag waaweyn oo leh baaraha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Haddii iyadoo dhirta ay ahaayd qalaf, ma aad u jeclaan lahaa tijaabta?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxay nu go'aansaday inay u tagaaan, waxayna ahaayeen waqtiga waaweyn, laakiin jidka waxay ahaayd adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Waan faraxsanahay inaad waxay ahaayeen waqtiga wanaagsan. Anigu waxaan jeclaa inaan u safaray meelaha cusub.

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Wuxuu u isticmaalaa inaan arrintan u soo baxdo, badan oo xumaan ah.
Firi qoraa oo ku saabsan in la dhaafo taathirka deegaanka.
Wuxuu u fududaa qayb ahaan ama qayb qaadan oo xaqiiq ah.
Magaca ugu muhiimsan ee mawduuca. Wuxuu la isticmaalaa 'the'.
Wuxuu u sheegayaa wax oo badan yahay ama la wada shaqeeyo.
Wuxuu u isticmaalaa in la ogaado in waxaan u ah midkood, sida 'single-use' (midkood keliya).
Wuxuu u sheegayaa adag. Wuxuu u ahaa adverbi oo ku saabsan hadalka.
Wuxuu u isticmaalaa in la sheego dhibaatooyin oo weyn yihiin ama muhiimsan.
Wuxuu u sheegayaa in xaaladdu weli ku jira. Wuxuu u isticmaali karayaa 'hadana'.
Marka ugu dambeynta hadalka wuxuu u yahay 'sey ahaan'. Marka ugu horreeynta hadalka wuxuu u yahay 'haddii'.
Wuxuu u isticmaalaa in la sheego ku xiga wax ama la dirir wax.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Waan u maleynayaa in qalabka qalabka waa dhibaato xadgudub leh, laakiin dadku weli ayay u isticmaali doonaan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Waan ogahay. Khalad caan ah waa in la isticmaalo qalabka qalabka midkood keliya oo dhan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Haddana. Adigoo u adeegsanayaa waxaad u ogolaan doontaa dhibaato badan oo degaanka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Haddana, maxay camalka ugu fiican oo aan qaadi karnaa inaan u dhaafno taathirka?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Haddana, inaad isticmaashid qalabka la isticmaali karo waa qayb qaadan mid ah. Waana u adag inuu noqoto adag.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Waxay u fahantahay. Ma aan ku xiranaynin khalad yar, sey. Wax walba waa ku caawina.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Aadaaha ugu dambe ayaan la doortay laba qaybood oo shaqo leh.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Waa qaarista adag. Maxaad qiyaastay khiyarrada?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Qiyaastay qufulada iyo safarka, laakiin khatar ku riday inaad u baxdo magaalada cusub ayaa ahaayd aad u weyn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Ma aad yaqeenaysaa natiijada khiyarrada oo dhan?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Maya, haddana waxaan ogay in qufulada shaqada labaad ay ay ahaayeen sare.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, maxaad si dambe u qaarti?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Shaqada ugu horreeyay ayaan doortay, ka badan shaqada labaad, sababtoo ah safarka gaaban yihiin oo u fiican yahay mawduuca shaqaalaha iyo nolosha.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Waan beddeli bay arrantii ku saabsan safarkii badda baradki.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Runtii? Sababtoo? Waxaad u maleynaysaa inaad u faraxsanaysid iyaga horay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaan ogaaday in taarikhda iftiinka xun buu tahay, oo si habboon, waxaan qabanayaa shaqo badan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Laakiin waxaad qorshe ahaat inaad u adagato oo aad u nacato shari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin waxaan ogaaday inaan la sami karin inaan dhammaan shaqadii aan u tagayo. Maxaa yeelay muddiga waxay tahay isniin, waan u baahan yahay inaan ugu dhaqo guriga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa xaqiiq ah. Laakiin waxaad shaqaysaa subaxdii oo aad u tagtaa dabadeed, meeshaas oo aan la dilayo waxa badan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Waxaa qofka wanaagsan, haddana waan u baahan yahay inaan arko haddii saaxiibbadeed ku tixraacayso safarka. Mahadsanid tashakusheeda!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa sidii ay dhexdooda jiraan farq badan oo dhexdooda oo ku salaysan dalalka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Haa, ilaa wax la mid ah salaaman ayaa u noqon karo dhowr oo beddela suxuunka dadka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Sida المثال, aduunkayga, waa liita inaad cunto gacantaada, laakiin baadha ay macaan u tahay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Cadadka ah waxaan ku filanayaa in dadku raacdo dhowrkii meeshii, laakiin waxaan jeclaa inaan u adkaado kuwo kale.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Waa wanaagsan. Waxaan u maleynayaa in dhowro badan ay isku mid yihiin xaaladda, laakiin ayay u soo bixiyaan kala duwan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa darteed, mishaarka waa inaad furto iyo inaad baryo farxanka dhexdooda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaan xidhiidho telefoon-ku cusub Wi-Fi, laakiin ma helin ayaha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Waa fudud. Taga app-ka ayaha oo doondo Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Ow, waan arkay. Laakiin aan jeclahay inaan soo gali app cusub oo messenger si aan u diro xog ayaan ku qayb galaya saaxiibbadeeyey.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Waa wax u fiican, laakiin eeg battery-ga ugu hore. Soo galinta waxay u isticmaali kartaa energy badan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Waad saxan tahay. Maxaan ku dhawaan scrin-ka? Mararka qaarkood wuxuu u dhexeeyaa wakhti dheer.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Waxaad ku bedeli kartaa ayaha, oo kale. Sida isticmaale, waa inaad la soo xiriirtid each-aada saaxiibbadaad haddii aad u rumaysan tahay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Mahadsanid! Hadda waan ku fiican yahay inaan isticmaal qalabkay internet.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion

Waxaa lagu isticmaalaa in la soo bixiyo burburiyo ama macluumaad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Arraantyada waa in dhibaato wuxuu yahay xaqiiqo budjetka shaqo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay nuqulkaga, laakiin, waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u eegay midaanka ugu horeeyey.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa nuqul xaqiiq ah. Markaasaa, owgayn waxaan la hadal galay laba oo dhan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ku liqnaynaa. Sidaa taas oo ay tahay, waxaan ka weyn ka codsan karnaa macluumaad ka badan kooxda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Fikrad wanaagsan. Sida burburinta ugu dambeeyey, waxay noo leh jimicsan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Markaasaa waxaan soo bandhig inaan diyaarinno bandhig labada doorasho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Waan u adku wahay walaashay maxaa yeelay ay tihiin xaqiiq ah, haddana markuu adag ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Waa mid wanaagsan. Saaxiibbadeedii ugu wanaagsan waa dagaal ah - mar ayuu u adeegay qof oo ku xumay qoraaga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Wow, waxaad u baahan tahay jaabin. Walaashayna waa adag oo badanaa ay tusaaleeyihiin jirta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Waxay ku dhex miisaan tahay u wanaagsan. Saaxiibbadeedii waa samra, laakiin wuu u eg yahay inuu ku noqdo fiil xun oo uu ku xumaynayo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Waan arkay. Walaashay waxay qaban tahay qabow, laakiin markaad u ogaato, waxay adag tahay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Waa mid wanaagsan. Saaxiibbadeedii wuxuu leeyahay faham weyn oo munaarada - ayuu iigu dhalaa inaan ku qaado.

scenario: Talking about education and learning

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaan u baro in aan barnaamij Ingiriiska ah, laakiin ma ayay hayo wakhti badan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Maxaad tijraac ma samaynaysaan aniga dhammaan galab? Waxaan u baahanahay inaan la baro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Waa fikrad wanaagsan, laakiin waa su'aal: ma waxaad u maleynaysaa in macalimihu wuxuu noogu caawin doonaa haddii aannu fahamnayn?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, macalimihu wuxuu jawaab su'aal walba tusaale xanuun ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Waan rajeynayaa inaan xusuusan doonaa erayada cusub oo aan baranno.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Haddii aad tijraacdo dhammaan maalinta, waxaad muuqataa inaad xusuusan doontaa si aad u caan ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Waxaad ku fiicnay. Ha nabad noqotay, waan noqon doonaa arday wanaagsan!

key_phrases.translation: Waa inaan u baro inaan u baro

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions

vocabulary.note: Loo isticmaalo 'problem'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Waxay nahay dhibaato weyn oo dhibaato weyn oo dhibaato weyn oo dhibaato weyn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay inay adag tahay, laakiin adag inaan helno hel adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan hel hel adag: waxaan u adag inaan u adag.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Waxay adag tahay in la sameeyo, laakiin ma adag in ay adag adag adag?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u adag inaan u adag, adag inaan u adag.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Qorshe wanaagsan. Waxaan u adag inaan u adag adag adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Ma dooran karo doorashada aan doortay inaan doorto safarada naga: biya kulul ama qiyaaraha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, biya kulul waa jiibsantahay ka badan qiyaaraha, laakiin waa dharasho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin qiyaaraha waxay qiimo badan yahay, waxaana u baahan yahay inaan soo gaadho degdeg ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa usoo, qiyaaraha way adag tahay, xaalad dambe oo fiid.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin qiyaaraha way qaali badan tahay, waxaana keeni karaynaa bagag yar oo badan oo biya kulul.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Waa run. Marka asaas ahaan waxaan u baahnay inaan qaano biya kulul oo aan bixino lacag yar.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Waa ii fiican, aan u socono biya kulul. Waxaan bixin karaynaa lacag oo aan ku raaxayno.

scenario: Talking about social media habits

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Sidee adigu cad u soojeedaya shabakadii bulshada?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Waan ku jiraa inaan la soo xayoono wax kastaba haa tahay, laakiin mararka qaarkood waan ku dhufo feed-ka aan soojeedin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Ma raycaysaa dad badan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin badan waan raacayaa saaxiib iyo qoyska. Ma ugu jeceshahay inaan helay 'ha u jeceshahay' ama sharci badan, sidaas daraaddeed waxaan qalad u samaynayaa profile-ka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Waa adag. Waxaan heyaa profile dadweynaha maxaa yeelay waan rabnaa dad badan inay arkaan soojeedkayga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay. Laakiin inaad internetka ku xidhaysid waxay noqon kartaa adag, sidaas daraaddeed waxaan xad gashay wakhtiga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaad u adag tahay. Mararka qaarkood waan ku dhex marayaa inaan samaan.

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxay u adeegsan yahay in la soo bandhigo qaybooyinka wax.

In presentations, 'main point' is the idea central.
Waxay u adeegsan yahay in la gujiyo qaybta dambe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaan bilaabno. Tafaacaadkaygan wuxuu u jiraa saddex qaybooyin oo kala duwan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Waxay fiican tahay. Maxaa nuqulkaagu ugu horeeya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Qaybta ugu horeeya waxay ku saabsan tahay xaaladdoonka iibka bilaha ugu dambeeyay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Maxaa aad ka dib ugu sheegi doontaa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Ka dib, waanan hadal doonaa wareeggoyinkaan u adag ee bilahaas.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Ma aad ugu hadashan doontaa isbeddelka cusub ee suuqta?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxaa nuqul muhiim ah, aanana dhamaystiran doonaa targetkii bilahaas.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Ma raacaysaa riyaadamo? Anigu waan u dhaqaaqaa kubbada.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waan arkayaa basketball. Diirkii aan ugu jeclaa waa Lakers, halkaa ayay guuleysteen macaamisha oo dhan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Waxay ciyaareen ku- Celtics habeenkii baxay, ma ahaatee? Mayee soobiyey magaaladii ugu badan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin waxay nagu helaynay. Ciyaaraha ugu fiican waxuu qaaday ciyaar u adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Waa kharaash. Ma waxaad u maleynaysaa inay leedahay fursad xogta cusub jilaalka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Owki, laakiin waa adag. Halkaa ayay leedahay ciyaaro fiican, waxay u baahnayeen inay sii fiicishaansada.
